purpose: Determine which plant family x trait systems can support both evolutionary-time and within-species geographic turnover before any trait value is returned.

system_grain.reason: Family defines a pre-outcome clade unit large enough for within-clade phylogenetic turnover while allowing multiple trait systems to be modeled with family-level clustering rather than treating them as independent.

record_filter.cultivated_primary: include only records where is_cultivated_observation = 0 OR is_cultivated_observation IS NULL
record_filter.rationale: Exclude records explicitly marked cultivated while retaining unknown status, matching BIEN's conservative non-cultivated query convention as closely as agg_traits permits.
record_filter.trait_value_use: presence predicate only; never selected or returned

projection.name: spherical Lambert cylindrical equal-area
projection.reason: Defines a deterministic global equal-area support grid without relying on server-side PostGIS transformation availability.

joint_gate.family_count_rule: A family contributes at most one independent cluster to the >=12 gate even if multiple traits qualify.

unit_diagnostic.rule: Unit heterogeneity does not rescue or fail structural support; exact trait representation and unit semantics are frozen in the next gate before values are opened.

allowed_outputs: distinct unit count and unit labels
aggregate counts of qualifying family x trait systems and independent families
next_gate_if_pass: Freeze trait representation/type, unit semantics, plant phylogeny crosswalk and observed-geometry informativeness simulations for the structurally qualifying family x trait systems before any trait values are opened.
next_gate_if_hold: Do not lower 20/8/20/5 or 12-family thresholds. Move to the already-frozen second trait source AusTraits only if the finite-family source-switch rule permits the BIEN structural HOLD.
